judge: grep 'render_mode:' and 'env: TU_DEBUG' in each logcat; python3 docs/lanes/flip474/sysmemjudge.py (PR #516) over 299-420 s on each arm; the cooling devices and thermal samples of each run; power.j_per_frame from each result.json if power.measured is true
units: GPU, R and X as printed use limits.timestampPeriod; the legs are ratios inside one pair on one device, or gfps.
prediction: #474: with no env and no per-game value, B reads AUF's title ID from the disc, finds it in the table and sets TU_DEBUG=sysmem; A does not. B reproduces flip474's sysmem-by-env arm (X/R 0.02, GPU 13.2, gfps 24) and A its base (X/R 1.01, GPU 24.9, gfps 16).

legs.M0 (instrument): >= 15 hakuX-phase lines with GPU > 0 in 299-420 s in each arm, and the screen shows play. Otherwise VOID for that arm, rerun once.
legs.E0 (engaged line): B's logcat has exactly one hakuX-build line 'render_mode: sysmem (table) title=4541000D TU_DEBUG=sysmem'; A has no render_mode line; neither arm has an 'env: TU_DEBUG' line. KILL: B has no such line, or it says auto/default, or a title other than 4541000D. VOID if either arm has an env TU_DEBUG line.
legs.D1 (the driver took it): B's X/R median <= 0.25 and A's >= 0.8. Confidence 90%. KILL of 'the default reaches the driver': B's X/R >= 0.8 with E0 holding.
legs.S2 (GPU falls): B's phase GPU median <= 0.75 x A's. Confidence 75% (flip474: 0.53 x).
legs.F1 (fps): B's gfps median >= 22 (flip474's sysmem arm read 24) and >= A's + 4. Confidence 65%.
legs.T0 (heat): neither arm shows the cpu3-7 thermal pause inside the window, and the smallest gfps line in the window is >= 0.6 x the median unless the screen shows a scene change. Otherwise VOID that arm (#507), rerun once after a cool-down.
legs.P0 (energy, reported not gated): if both result.json files say power.measured true: report j_per_frame for both. Guess: B <= A, confidence 55%. A gain in gfps with a loss in J/frame is reported as such.
legs.H0 (no hang): each arm: hakuX-perf lines to the end of the run, no crash marker, and no gap between them longer than 2 x the arm's median gap (flip474's fixed 3 s bound was wrong under 19 gfps).
